summary: A marketing header nav with Products and Resources disclosure buttons that open panels of links (Products links carry a description), followed by Pricing (the current page) and Contact links.
use: The primary navigation of a marketing site: a few top-level links and a couple of grouped panels, reachable by hover, click and keyboard.
spec: `<NavigationMenu aria-label="Main">` renders a navigation landmark with a list
`<NavigationMenuItem label="Products">` and `<NavigationMenuItem label="Resources">` are disclosure buttons whose children are `NavigationMenuLink`s
Products links pass `description` for a second line that is part of the link name
`<NavigationMenuLink href="#pricing" current>` marks the current page; Contact is a plain link
